description: result = 1 when the wired value equals Match, else 0. The select-branching primitive: turn a select param ('u-shape') into a 0/1 gate that drives Loop counts.
instructions:
String/number equality test: publishes `val-result` = 1 when the wired `value` equals the `match` text, else 0. This is how a SELECT parameter branches a flow: wire a select's value (e.g. an Input Properties / Parametric Object `config`) into Value, set Match to one option ('straight' / 'u-shape'), and multiply the resulting 0/1 into a Loop's Count — the branch's geometry vanishes when the option isn't active (count 0 = no copies).

TIP: one Match node per option, then `count = N × match` via a Math node.
